description: This file defines the 'BuzzShare' entity class for a social media feature within the OrangeHRM system. It models a shared post with properties like post reference, employee, likes, comments, content text, share time, and type. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes helper traits and decorators.

classes.name: BuzzShare
classes.description: Entity representing a shared post in the social feature of OrangeHRM, including properties such as the related post, employee, likes, comments, content, timestamps, and type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the BuzzShare instance.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the BuzzShare instance.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who shared the post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who shared the post.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of share (post or share).

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the share.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the share.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation time in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation time in UTC to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated time in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the last updated time in UTC to current UTC time.
